answer.finalSql: SELECT SUM("daily_new_deaths") AS "covid_deaths_last_year" FROM "86440223-249d-4b3d-9be4-159a4e615e0a" WHERE "date" >= (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('year', max("date")) - INTERVAL 1 YEAR FROM "86440223-249d-4b3d-9be4-159a4e615e0a") AND "date" < (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('year', max("date")) FROM "86440223-249d-4b3d-9be4-159a4e615e0a")
answer.assistantText: This totals new COVID deaths in the United States for 2025, the last full calendar year in the data (the data runs to 2026, so "last year" is 2025). It uses the US deaths dataset and includes all states and unassigned rows.
